t: Martial eagle | Description, Prey, Conservation Status, & Facts | Britannica
s: November 2, 2023 - martial eagle, (Polemaetus bellicosus), large, long-winged eagle inhabiting dry grassland, scrubland, and scattered woodland habitats of sub-Saharan Africa. The martial eagle is one of the largest birds of prey in the world, and, with a length reaching up to 96 cm (37 inches) long and a weight up to 6.5 kg (14 pounds), it is the largest eagle in Africa.
